event_var.var_meaning: distant metastasis-free survival event indicator; inferred coding 1 = distant metastasis event, 0 = censored/no event, NA = missing

notes: GSM metadata explicitly contains 'dmfs time' and 'dmfs event' for samples in GSE113863.
Many samples have 'dmfs time: NA' and 'dmfs event: NA'; the series metadata states that 303 of 483 RNA-seq samples had survival data.
The unit is not stated in GSM metadata; 'years' is taken from the paper, which describes DMFS analyses with follow-up up to 10 years and numeric values consistent with year-based times.
The 0/1 event coding is not explicitly defined in the GSM records; meaning is inferred from the endpoint name and standard Kaplan-Meier/Cox survival analysis described in the paper.
